text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arab group at the United Nations calls for the withdrawal of Turkish troops from northern Iraq.
- Iraq denies obstructing flights by U.N. helicopters.
- Iraq accuses U.N. arms inspectors of smuggling banned items through Habaniya airport.
- Health minister says delay in arrival of medical supplies causes the death of 120 children a day.
- Arab League secretary-general calls for an Arab summit to discuss water resources in Arab countries.
- Harvest ends in the southern province of Basra.
- Italian delegation to visit Iraq soon.
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and AL-IRAQ)
- Editorial accuses the United States of deliberate attempts to delay implementation of "oil-for-food" deal between Iraq and the United Nations.
- Commentary calls for a serious and unified Arab stand against America.
- Commentary says Israel backs Turkey in its invasion of northern Iraq.
- Editorial says U.S. dominance of world affairs to wane soon.
